title: Bricks for the {place}
Clay and fire
summary: The {place} in {settlement} is waiting on bricks. Bring {count} × {item} to {giver}.
{settlement}'s kiln has gone cold and the {place} wants {count} × {item}.
offer: We fire our own bricks, but the clay pit's run dry and the {place} is only half-faced. {count} × {item} would finish it.
I need {count} × {item} for the {place}. The kiln can't keep up.
progress: Half a wall is no wall at all.
complete: Lovely and even. The {place} will look a picture.
Thank you. The bricklayers are singing again.
